vi + √bhās > bhass + a + ika + tā
vibhassika + tā

68602.commentary: (DHPa) bhavāya vibhavāya cā'ti vuddhiyā ca avuddhiyā ca.

examples.text: yogā ve jāyatī bhūri, ayogā bhūrisaṅkhayo, etaṃ dvedhāpathaṃ ñatvā, bhavāya vibhavāya ca, tath'āttānaṃ niveseyya, yathā bhūri pavaḍḍhati.
bhav'ev'āhaṃ bhayaṃ disvā, bhavañ'ca vibhav'esinaṃ, bhavaṃ n'ābhivadiṃ kiñci, nandiñ'ca na upādiyin'ti.
venayiko samaṇo gotamo sato sattassa ucchedaṃ vināsaṃ vibhavaṃ paññāpetī'ti

68604.commentary: (THIa) phītañ'c'imaṃ gahavibhavaṃ pahāyā'ti imaṃ hatthiādippabhedaṃ yathāvuttaṃ avuttañ'ca khetta-vatthu-hirañña-suvaṇṇ'ādi-bhedaṃ phītaṃ pahūtañ'ca gahavibhavaṃ geh'ūpakaraṇaṃ aññañ'ca dāsidās'ādikaṃ sabbaṃ pahāya tava pitā pabbajito.

examples.text: hatthī gav'assaṃ maṇikuṇḍalañ'ca, phītañ'c'imaṃ gahavibhavaṃ pahāya, pitā pabbajito tuyhaṃ, bhuñja bhogāni sundari, tuvaṃ dāy'ādikā kule.

68605.meaning1: craving for nonexistence; craving for annihilation; (or) craving (for something) to not exist

examples.text: y'āyaṃ taṇhā ponobhavikā nandirāgasahagatā tatratatr'ābhinandinī, seyyath'idaṃ, kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhā
katamā tisso? kāmatasinā, bhavatasinā, vibhavatasinā. imāsaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tissannaṃ tasinānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya …

68607.commentary: (SNa) rūpaṃ vibhavissatī'ti rūpaṃ bhijjissati. (SNt) vibhavissatī'ti vinassissati. vibhavo hi vināso. ten'āha bhijjissatī'ti.

examples.text: rūpaṃ vibhavissatī'ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. vedanā vibhavissati… saññā vibhavissati… saṅkhārā vibhavissanti… viññāṇaṃ vibhavissatī'ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.

68608.meaning1: view of nonexistence; belief in non-being

examples.text: dve'mā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhiyo, bhavadiṭṭhi ca vibhavadiṭṭhi ca.
ākhyāta-sāgaram'ath'ajjatanī-taraṅ'gaṃ, dhātujjalaṃ vikaraṇ'āgamakālamīnaṃ, lop'ānubandh'ariyam'atthavibhāgatīraṃ, dhīrā taranti kavino puthubuddhināvā.

vi + √bhaj > bhag > bhāg + *a + vant
vibhāga + vant

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato ānandassa etadahosi, sace kho ahaṃ kosinārake malle ekam'ekaṃ bhagavantaṃ vandāpessāmi, avandito bhagavā kosinārakehi mallehi bhavissati, ath'āyaṃ ratti vibhāyissati.

68617.meaning2: in some places; in some contexts; optionally

examples.text: katamā adiṭṭhajotanā pucchā? pakatiyā lakkhaṇaṃ aññātaṃ hoti adiṭṭhaṃ atulitaṃ atīritaṃ avibhūtaṃ avibhāvitaṃ, tassa ñāṇāya dassanāya tulanāya tīraṇāya vibhāvanāya pañhaṃ pucchati, ayaṃ adiṭṭhajotanā pucchā.
ye ariyasaccāni vibhāvayanti, gambhīrapaññena sudesitāni, kiñ'c'āpi te honti bhusaṃ pamattā, na te bhavaṃ aṭṭhamam'ādiyanti, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
yaṃ viditvā sato caran'ti yaṃ viditaṃ katvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā.

68625.synonym: ñāṇī, dhīra, nipaka, pañña, paññava, paññavant, paññāṇavant, paññāvant, paṇḍita, matimant, matīmant, mutimant, mutīmant, viññujātika, viññū, sapañña, sappañña
68625.commentary: (SNPa) viññū vibhāvī nipuṇo ca hotī'ti viññutāsaṅkhātāya paññāya adhigamena viññū, vibhāvetvā paresam'pi pākaṭaṃ katvā ñāpanasamatthatāya vibhāvī, paramasukhum'attha-paṭivedhatāya nipuṇo ca hoti.

examples.text: tadaṭṭhikatvāna nisamma dhīro, dhamm'ānudhammaṃ paṭipajjamāno, viññū vibhāvī nipuṇo ca hoti, yo tādisaṃ bhajati appamatto.

68627.meaning2: should be cultivated; should be developed

examples.text: passa puññānaṃ vipākaṃ, kusalānaṃ sukh'esino, mettaṃ cittaṃ vibhāvetvā, satta vassāni bhikkhavo, sattasaṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe, na'y'imaṃ lokaṃ punāgamiṃ.
kadā nu gaṅgaṃ yamunaṃ sarassatiṃ, pātālakhittaṃ vaḷavāmukhañ'ca, asajjamāno patareyyam'iddhiyā, vibhiṃsanaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

68637.meaning1: vanished; disappeared; ended; ceased; does not exist

examples.text: vibhūtarūpasaññissa, sabbakāyappahāyino, ajjhattañ'ca bahiddhā ca, n'atthi kiñcī'ti passato, ñāṇaṃ sakk'ānupucchāmi, kathaṃ neyyo tathāvidho.
phasso nu lokasmi kutonidāno, pariggahā c'āpi kutopahūtā, kismiṃ asante na mamattam'atthi, kismiṃ vibhūte na phusanti phassā.

68638.commentary: (NIDD1a) vibhūtaṃ katvā'ti nipphattiṃ pāpetvā āveṇikaṃ katvā. atha vā saṃkiṇṇadosaṃ mocetvā vatthuvibhāgakaraṇena passitvā.

examples.text: yaṃ viditvā sato caran'ti yaṃ viditaṃ katvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā.

68639.meaning2: fact of having disappeared; fact of having vanished

68641.meaning1: with vanished perception; without awareness; (comm) percipient of the formless
68641.commentary: (NIDD1) no'pi asaññī na vibhūtasaññī'ti. asaññino vuccanti nirodhasamāpannā ye ca asaññasattā, na'pi so nirodhasamāpanno, na'pi asaññasatto. vibhūtasaññino vuccanti ye catunnaṃ arūpasamāpattīnaṃ lābhino, na'pi so catunnaṃ arūpasamāpattīnaṃ lābhī'ti, no'pi asaññī na vibhūtasaññī. (SNPa) no'pi asaññī'ti saññāvirahitopi na hoti nirodhasamāpanno vā asaññasatto vā. na vibhūtasaññī'ti sabbaso rūpasaññānan'ti-ādinā (dha sa. 265, vibha. 602) nayena samatikkantasaññī'pi na hoti arūpajjhānalābhī.

examples.text: na saññasaññī na visaññasaññī, no'pi asaññī na vibhūtasaññī, evaṃ sametassa vibhoti rūpaṃ, saññānidānā hi papañcasaṅkhā.
vibhūtasaññino vuccanti ye catunnaṃ arūpasamāpattīnaṃ lābhino, na'pi so catunnaṃ arūpasamāpattīnaṃ lābhī'ti.
mahāmāyā'pi devī pure puṇṇamāya sattamadivasato paṭṭhāya vigatasurāpānaṃ mālāgandhavibhūtisampannaṃ nakkhattakīḷaṃ anubhavamānā sattame divase pāto'va uṭṭhāya
naccagītavāditavisūkadassanā paṭivirato ahosiṃ. mālāgandhavilepanadhāraṇamaṇḍanavibhūsanaṭṭhānā paṭivirato ahosiṃ.
bhojane mattaññuno bhavissāma paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āharissāma n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya

68644.commentary: (VISM) na vibhūsanāyā'ti na naṭanaccak'ādayo viya vibhūsan'atthaṃ, pasanna-cchavivaṇṇatā-nimittan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: bhojane mattaññuno bhavissāma paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āharissāma n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya
niddaṃ na bahulīkareyya, jāgariyaṃ bhajeyya ātāpī, tandiṃ māyaṃ hassaṃ khiḍḍaṃ, methunaṃ vippajahe savibhūsaṃ.
bhesajjesu yathā vejjā, kicc'ākicce yathā gihī, gaṇikā'va vibhūsāyaṃ, issare khattiyā yathā.
gandh'odakena nhāyitvā cattāri satasahassāni vissajjetvā mahādānaṃ datvā sabb'ālaṅ'kāravibhūsitā varabhojanaṃ bhuñjitvā uposath'aṅgāni adhiṭṭhāya

68648.meaning1: having adorned; having ornamented; having dressed up

examples.text: vibhūsetvā imaṃ kāyaṃ, sucittaṃ bālalāpanaṃ, aṭṭhāsiṃ vesidvāramhi, luddo pāsam'iv'oḍḍiya.
kathaṃ sametassa vibhoti rūpaṃ, sukhaṃ dukhañ'cā'pi kathaṃ vibhoti, etaṃ me pabrūhi yathā vibhoti, taṃ jāniyāmā'ti me mano ahu.
na saññasaññī na visaññasaññī, no'pi asaññī na vibhūtasaññī. evaṃ sametassa vibhoti rūpaṃ, saññānidānā hi papañcasaṅkhā.

68651.meaning1: smoothes out; irons out; removes the wrinkles
68651.commentary: (VINa) ussāpetvā punappunaṃ vimajjatī'ti valīsu naṭṭhāsu idaṃ mahantaṃ bhavissatī'ti maññamāno udakena siñcitvā pādehi akkamitvā hatthehi ussāpetvā ukkhipitvā piṭṭhiyaṃ ghaṃsati, taṃ ātape sukkhaṃ paṭhamappamāṇam'eva hoti. so puna'pi tathā karoti, tena vuttaṃ ussāpetvā punappunaṃ vimajjatī'ti.

68652.commentary: (MNa) no vimajjanakkhamo'ti saviññāṇako maṇipāsāṇena vimaddiyamāno nillomataṃ nicchavitañ'ca āpajjati, aviññāṇako'pi vacuṇṇakabhāvaṃ āpajjati. tasmā evam'āha.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, bhante, rattapāṇi rajakaputto taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca, ayaṃ kho te, makkaṭacchāpako raṅgakkhamo hi kho, no ākoṭanakkhamo, no vimajjanakkhamo'ti.

68653.meaning1: able to be rubbed; can be smoothed
68653.commentary: (MNa) no vimajjanakkhamo'ti saviññāṇako maṇipāsāṇena vimaddiyamāno nillomataṃ nicchavitañ'ca āpajjati, aviññāṇako'pi vacuṇṇakabhāvaṃ āpajjati. tasmā evam'āha.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, bhante, rattapāṇi rajakaputto taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca, ayaṃ kho te, makkaṭacchāpako raṅgakkhamo hi kho, no ākoṭanakkhamo, no vimajjanakkhamo'ti.

68654.meaning1: smoothing out; ironing out; removing the wrinkles
68654.commentary: (VINa) ussāpetvā punappunaṃ vimajjatī'ti valīsu naṭṭhāsu idaṃ mahantaṃ bhavissatī'ti maññamāno udakena siñcitvā pādehi akkamitvā hatthehi ussāpetvā ukkhipitvā piṭṭhiyaṃ ghaṃsati, taṃ ātape sukkhaṃ paṭhamappamāṇam'eva hoti. so puna'pi tathā karoti, tena vuttaṃ ussāpetvā punappunaṃ vimajjatī'ti.

68655.commentary: (MNa) ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhan'ti maṇipāsāṇena ubhosu passesu suṭṭhu vimaṭṭhaṃ ghaṭṭetvā uppāditacchaviṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma umāpupphaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ, seyyathā vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ.
upasaṅkamitvā rattapāṇiṃ rajakaputtaṃ evaṃ vadehi, icchām'ahaṃ, samma rattapāṇi, imaṃ makkaṭacchāpakaṃ pīt'āvalepanaṃ nāma raṅgajātaṃ rajitaṃ ākoṭitapaccākoṭitaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhan'ti.

68656.synonym: āsaṅkā, kaṅkhā, kaṅkhitā, kathaṅkathā, kathaṃkathā, vicikicchā, vicikicchitā, vicchikicchā, saṅkā
68656.commentary: (DNa) kaṅkhā'ti sabbaññū, na sabbaññū'ti evaṃ saṃsayo. vimatī'ti tass'eva vevacanaṃ, virūpā mati, vinicchinituṃ asamatthā'ti attho.

examples.text: siyā kho pana bhikkhave ekabhikkhuss'āpi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā pucchatha bhikkhave mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha

kiṃ te idha sārasammataṃ, kuṇapapūramhi susānavaḍḍhane, bhedanadhamme kaḷevare, yaṃ disvā vimano udikkhasi.

68661.meaning1: no boundary; no border; no limit

68662.commentary: (SNa) vimariyādikatenā'ti nimmariyādikatena. tattha duvidhā mariyādā kilesamariyādā vaṭṭamariyādā'ti. tattha ca yassa upaḍḍhā kilesā pahīnā, upaḍḍhā appahīnā, vaṭṭaṃ vā pana upaḍḍhaṃ pahīnaṃ, upaḍḍhaṃ appahīnaṃ, tassa cittaṃ pahīnakilese vā vaṭṭaṃ vā sandhāya vimariyādikataṃ, appahīnakilese vā vaṭṭaṃ vā sandhāya na vimariyādikataṃ. idha pana ubhayassā'pi pahīnattā vimariyādikatena cetasā'ti vuttaṃ, mariyādaṃ akatvā ṭhitena atikkantamariyādena cetasā'ti attho.

examples.text: yāvakīvañ'c'ime, bhikkhave, sattā imāsaṃ catunnaṃ dhātūnaṃ assādañ'ca assādato ādīnavañ'ca ādīnavato nissaraṇañ'ca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ na abbhaññaṃsu, n'eva tāvime bhikkhave, sattā sadevakā lokā samārakā sabrahmakā sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya nissaṭā visaṃyuttā vippamuttā vimariyādikatena cetasā vihariṃsu.
evaṃ na katthati na vikatthati. katthanā ārato virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharatī'ti, iti'han'ti sīlesu akatthamāno.
katihi nu kho, bhante, dhammehi tathāgato nissaṭo visaṃyutto vippamutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharatī'ti?
diṭṭhe kho ahaṃ, āvuso, anupāyo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharāmi.
bāhitvā sabbapāpakāni, vimalo sādhusamāhito ṭhit'atto, saṃsāram'aticca kevalī so, asito tādi pavuccate sa brahmā.
candaṃ'va vimalaṃ suddhaṃ, vippasannam'anāvilaṃ, nandībhavaparikkhīṇaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

68665.meaning1: stainless one; immaculate one; unblemished being; epithet of the Buddha

68675.commentary: (SNa) na vimānam'ajjhagā'ti navabhedaṃ tividhamānaṃ na upagato. nivās'aṭṭhena vā mātukucchi vimānan'ti vuccati, taṃ āyatiṃ paṭisandhivasena na upagacchī'ti'pi attho

68691.meaning1: because of undertaking morally mixed actions

68697.meaning1: unhappy; averse; grimacing; pulling a face
68697.commentary: (ANa) vimukhā kammaṃ karontī'ti pāto kiñci na labhāma, khudāya paṭipīḷitā kammaṃ kātuṃ na sakkomā'ti kammaṃ vissajjetvā nisīdanti.

examples.text: ye te atithī pāhunā, te na kālena paṭipūjenti, yā tā balipaṭiggāhikā devatā, tā na kālena paṭipūjenti, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā ekabhattikā ratt'ūparatā viratā vikālabhojanā, te na kālena paṭipūjenti, dāsakammakaraporisā vimukhā kammaṃ karonti, tāvatakaṃ'y'eva asamayena bhuttaṃ anojavantaṃ hoti.
